get.description: Issues a cryptographically secure, single-use nonce tied to the given Stellar wallet address. The nonce expires after 5 minutes and replaces any previous unused nonce for this wallet.

post.description: Issues a single-use nonce tied to the given Stellar wallet address. The response includes the exact UTF-8 message the wallet must sign with its ED25519 private key. The nonce expires after 5 minutes (configurable) and is consumed on the first login attempt, whether or not the signature is valid.

400.description: Request body failed validation (e.g. address is not a valid Stellar public key).

post.description: Authenticates a Stellar wallet by verifying the ED25519 signature over the nonce message returned by POST /auth/nonce. On success, issues an access/refresh token pair. The nonce is consumed regardless of outcome and cannot be reused.

200.description: Authentication successful. Returns a short-lived access token and a single-use refresh token.

401.description: Signature is invalid, the nonce has already been used, or no nonce exists for this address.

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair. The presented refresh token is immediately invalidated (single-use rotation), so concurrent refresh calls with the same token will result in one success and one 401.

400.description: refreshToken is not a valid JWT string.

401.description: Refresh token is expired, has already been used, or was issued for a different token type.

post.description: Revokes the caller's current access token by adding its JTI to the blacklist, and optionally invalidates the accompanying refresh token if supplied in the body. Requires a valid Bearer access token in the Authorization header.

requestBody.description: Optionally supply the refresh token to invalidate it immediately.

204.description: Logged out successfully. No response body.

post.description: Invalidates every active refresh token for the authenticated user and increments their token version, which invalidates all previously issued access and refresh tokens.

info.title: SkillSync API
info.description: REST API for the SkillSync platform. Authentication is wallet-based (Stellar ED25519): request a nonce, sign it, exchange the signature for JWT tokens.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Wallet login and token lifecycle endpoints.

tags.name: Wallet
tags.description: Nonce issuance for Stellar wallet sign-in.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Username, display name, and public profile endpoints.

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description: Mentor and mentee profile creation and management.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Admin-only endpoints. Require the ADMIN role.

BearerAuth.description: Paste the accessToken returned by POST /auth/login. Format: Bearer <token>

nonce.description: Single-use cryptographically secure nonce (64-character hex string).

expiresAt.description: Time at which the nonce expires.

field.description: Dotted path of the offending field.

example: address must be a valid Stellar public key
errors.description: Human-readable validation messages for the field.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Clients should branch on this, not on message.

path.description: Request path that produced the error.

requestId.description: Correlation id of the request (from the X-Request-Id header when supplied).

errors.description: Per-field validation details. Only present on VALIDATION_FAILED responses.

address.description: Stellar wallet public key (ED25519) that will sign the login message.

nonce.description: Single-use random nonce (64 hex characters). Embedded in the login message.

message.description: The exact UTF-8 string the wallet must sign with its ED25519 private key. Do not modify the message before signing.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until this nonce expires. The default window is 300 seconds (5 minutes).

address.description: Stellar wallet public key that owns the pending nonce.

signature.description: Base64-encoded ED25519 signature of the exact login message returned by POST /auth/nonce. The nonce is consumed on first use and cannot be replayed.

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT for authenticating API requests. Send as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Defaults to a 15-minute lifetime.

refreshToken.description: Long-lived JWT used exclusively to obtain a new token pair via POST /auth/refresh. Single-use; the previous refresh token is invalidated on each rotation. Defaults to a 7-day lifetime.
The refresh token issued by POST /auth/login or a previous POST /auth/refresh. Each refresh token is single-use; a new pair is returned on success.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the latest account update.

isFeatured.description: True when this user has an active featured mentor profile.

featuredBadge.description: Badge shown on featured mentor cards.

isVerified.description: Whether this user has a verified mentor profile.

verifiedBadge.description: Badge shown on verified mentor cards.

status.description: New account status. Restores soft-deleted accounts to active when set to "active".

available.description: True when the username is both syntactically valid and not already taken.

reason.description: Human-readable reason when available is false.

username.description: Desired username. Must be 3–30 characters, contain only letters, digits, underscores, and dashes, start and end with a letter or digit, and have no consecutive special characters.

walletAddress.description: Stellar wallet public key (ED25519). Unique account identifier.

username.description: Unique username chosen by the user. 3–30 characters, alphanumeric plus underscores and dashes, no consecutive special characters, cannot start or end with a special character. Null until the user sets one.

displayName.description: Public display name. Up to 50 characters, no uniqueness requirement. Defaults to the first 8 characters of the wallet address when not set.

role.description: Primary role used for list filtering. Denormalised from the user_roles relation so the (role, status, createdAt) composite index can serve admin list queries without a join.

education.description: Optional education history. Contributes to the profile completeness bonus.

certifications.description: Optional certifications. Contributes to the profile completeness bonus.

usernameChangedAt.description: When the username was last changed. Used to enforce the 30-day cooldown between changes.

displayName.description: Display name shown publicly on the profile. Up to 50 characters. Send null or omit the field to reset to the default (first 8 characters of the wallet address).

displayName.description: Display name. Returns the user-set display name, or the first 8 characters of the wallet address when none has been set.

featuredBadge.description: Badge shown on featured mentor cards.

verifiedBadge.description: Badge shown on verified mentor profiles and cards.

platform.description: Optional; detected from URL when omitted

profileType.description: Which profile type to create. A user may hold at most one of each type.

bio.description: [mentor] Short professional bio. Required when profileType is "mentor".
bio.example: Senior engineer with 10 years in distributed systems.

skills.description: [mentor] Skills this mentor teaches. 1–20 strings, each up to 64 characters. Required when profileType is "mentor".

hourlyRateUsdCents.description: [mentor] Hourly rate in USD cents (e.g. 5000 = $50.00). Omit or send null to list as free / negotiate offline.

maxMentees.description: [mentor] Maximum number of active mentees to accept. Defaults to 3 if omitted.

learningGoals.description: [mentee] Learning goals the mentee wants to achieve (1–20 items, max 500 chars each). Required when profileType is "mentee".
example: Transition from backend to full-stack development

interests.description: [mentee] Topics the mentee wants to focus on. 1–20 strings, each up to 64 characters. Required when profileType is "mentee".

budgetUsdCentsPerMonth.description: [mentee] Maximum monthly budget in USD cents. Omit or send null for no preference.

experienceLevel.description: [mentee] Self-assessed current skill level. Required when profileType is "mentee".

preferredMentoringStyle.description: [mentee] Preferred mentoring styles (e.g. career advice, technical skills, interview prep).

timeCommitmentHoursPerWeek.description: [mentee] Time commitment in hours per week.

languages.description: Languages for mentorship sessions. Defaults to ["English"] if omitted.
